# Maximus Partner generators

**Every model in `../models/` is generated by these scripts.** Do not hand-edit models — edit the
generator and re-run, or the next run reverts you.

Input: `../../maximum_partner/04_column_map.json`. Unlike travel there is no key worksheet to
overlay — this map states one key rule per (view, anchor) and the payload/child key per
(view, satellite), so the map is the whole key layer. Plain Python 3, no dependencies.

## Run order

```bash
python build_mp_spec.py       # map -> _mp_spec.json
python gen_mp_staging.py      # layer 1: 8 casts
python gen_mp_stage.py        # wide stage() per view
python gen_mp_unpivot.py      # multi-active satellites, one row per instance
python gen_mp_vault.py        # hubfeed, hubs, links, satellites
python gen_mp_augmented.py    # the unconfirmed SAT_AUG_* track
```

## Both gates are NOT optional

```bash
python ../../vault_tools/check_internal.py ..
python ../../vault_tools/check_vault_alignment.py .. ../../partner_dv_dbt ../../maximum_partner/04_column_map.json
```

## THE ONE THING THAT IS DIFFERENT ABOUT PARTNER

**`partner_dv_dbt` renders payload columns SQUASHED, and it is the only sibling that does.**
ADDRESSLINE1, POSTALCODE, COMMISSIONSTRUCTURE, AGREEMENTTYPE. Measured over the satellites `data_7`
knows:

| sibling | squashed-only | UPPER_SNAKE-only |
|---|---|---|
| `partner_dv_dbt` | **131** | 19 |
| `travel_dv_dbt` | 0 | 102 |
| `health_dv_dbt` | 0 | 411 |
| `motor_dv_dbt` | 0 | 136 |

Carrying travel's UPPER_SNAKE across would have opened a second column for every fact that already
has one — in the one project where the majority convention runs the other way. `attr_col` in
`mp_names.py` encodes partner's; the alignment gate DETECTS it from the sibling rather than
assuming, and that is what proves the choice.

## The other things that bite

**1. This source is a PARTY shred.** The root document IS the party, so `FOREIGN_KEY` on any
sub-view is the party's own key and `HUB_PARTY` keys on it legitimately. The guardrail against
`FOREIGN_KEY` bans keying a *sub*-hub on another entity's root — here HUB_PARTY *is* the root.
Every other anchor still names its own key.

**2. The sibling's contract is absolute.** Deriving a grain for a satellite `partner_dv_dbt`
already builds made four of its single-active satellites multi-active. The gate caught it. A
satellite it builds takes its grain, `src_pk` and `src_cdk` verbatim.

**3. Never invent a child key.** The first cut named the child key after the satellite and produced
`PARTYIDENTIFICATION`, a column no one asked for. A child key is a property of the MODEL, so where
the map names none, another OPUS build that carries the same satellite is the authoritative source
(health writes `SAT_LNK_PARTY_ROLE_CORE` on ROLE_CODE + ROLE_SEQUENCE). Where no build carries it,
it is reported, not guessed.

**4. A link's key is composed from its legs**, and a link whose two legs are the SAME hub needs two
distinct key columns — the map spells both out, and `link_legs_from_rule` parses them. Aliasing the
second onto the first would file every relationship as self-referential.

**5. Generated names must stay unique when shortened.** `_fit` appends a digest; truncation alone
is not injective.

**6. A generator must never write to a file it reads** — asserted over the whole input set.

## State

167 models, both gates PASS, reproducible from an empty `models/`.

| layer | models |
|---|---|
| layer-1 casts | 8 |
| wide stage + unpivot stage | 18 |
| unpivot views | 9 |
| hubfeed | 15 |
| hubs · links | 9 · 3 |
| standard satellites | **47 of 47 targeted** |
| augmented stage / satellites | 8 / 51 |

**100% of mapped columns reach a satellite** (220 of 220). 497 of 547 augmentation columns are
placed, 90 of them through the advocate multi-active unpivot.

Reported, not guessed: 2 (view, satellite) pairs the map marks multi-active without naming a
discriminator (`SAT_PARTY_AGENT_LICENCE_LINE`) — they build single-active today; 18 augmentation
columns with no resolvable anchor; 4 advocate-family columns carrying no role suffix. All in
`../../maximum_partner/MAXIMUS_PARTNER_AUG_UNROUTED.csv`.

## The four source-owner asks — all built ahead

`PARTNER_PREEMPTIVE_ANSWERS.md` directs the builder to proceed on a stated assumption for each;
none blocks, and when the source lands it re-keys the affected rows with **no mapping change**.

1. **`SAT_PARTY_ORG_DIRECTORS`** — the model keys directors on DIN Number and the source has none.
   Built multi-active on the officer ROLE token (`PERSONROLE`: AUTHORISED_SIGNATORY /
   MEDICAL_DIRECTOR / OWNER / …), one holder per role, DIN null. All 11 columns already carried
   their role in `child_key_value`; only the child key's NAME was missing, and 'Person Role' is the
   satellite's own canonical attribute for it. See `BUILD_AHEAD_CK` in `build_mp_spec.py`.
2. **MULTI_SET spine (7 cols)** — built; they load single-instance until the source re-exports
   `MULTI_SET_NAME` + `SEQUENCE_NUMBER`, at which point the child keys populate.
3. **`insufficient_sample_data`** — built on the map's one-party reading of the advocate family.
4. **`list_valued_column_split_rule`** — `BENEFICIARY_NAME` is the keyed writer; the list attribute
   splits at load when the delimiter is confirmed.

The shared-vault HASHDIFF divergence applies here too — see `../../vault_tools/README.md`.
